articles.title: India Advances National Data Governance Framework Policy 2026
articles.summary: MeitY issues revised guidelines to facilitate non-personal data sharing for domestic AI development while protecting sovereign digital assets.
prelims: Non-personal data comprises anonymized datasets from which personal identifiers have been removed.
Establishes the India Data Management Office (IDMO) under MeitY to oversee data access standards.
Exempts strategic datasets related to national security and defense from public sharing mandates.
articles.mains: Use in GS2 (Governance/E-Governance) to analyze the balance between data democratization, state sovereignty, and privacy rights.

articles.title: Cabinet Approves Phase II Expansion of National Quantum Mission
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet approves enhanced funding for quantum communication security protocols and thematic research hubs across top institutes.
prelims: National Quantum Mission is spearheaded by the Department of Science and Technology (DST).
Operates through four main Thematic Hubs (T-Hubs): Computation, Communication, Sensing & Metrology, and Materials.
Aims to construct intermediate-scale quantum computers with 50 to 1,000 physical qubits.
articles.mains: Crucial for GS3 (Science and Technology) answers on emerging technologies, indigenous R&D capability, and technological self-reliance.

articles.title: MoEFCC Releases State of Marine Biodiversity Report 2026
articles.summary: A comprehensive national evaluation highlights resilience strategies for vulnerable coral reef ecosystems in Lakshadweep and the Andaman Sea.
prelims: Lakshadweep consists mainly of coral atolls, whereas the Andaman and Nicobar Islands predominantly feature fringing reefs.
Aligns India's national targets with the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (30x30 target).
Integrated Coastal Zone Management Plan (ICZMP) acts as the primary governance mechanism for coastal protection.
articles.mains: Use in GS3 (Environment & Ecology) questions on coastal ecosystem preservation, ocean warming resilience, and biodiversity conservation.

articles.title: Supreme Court Bench Elaborates Guidelines on Sub-Categorisation within Reserved Classes
articles.summary: The Supreme Court underscores the necessity of empirical data to justify sub-classification among Scheduled Castes to ensure targeted affirmative action.
prelims: Articles 341 and 342 empower the President to notify the list of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
States can sub-classify SC/ST lists only if backed by quantifiable data of inadequate representation.
The landmark Indra Sawhney Case (1992) established the 50% cap on total reservations and the concept of the creamy layer.
articles.mains: High utility in GS2 (Polity and Social Justice) for questions regarding social equity, affirmative action design, and judicial interpretation of constitutional rights.

articles.title: RBI Expands Offline Digital Rupee (e₹) Pilots to Rural Sectors
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India rolls out network-independent offline functionality for the Central Bank Digital Currency to strengthen last-mile financial inclusion.
prelims: Digital Rupee (e₹) is sovereign currency issued by the RBI under amendments to the RBI Act, 1934.
Offline e₹ transactions utilize Near Field Communication (NFC) and hardware-based secure elements without requiring active internet connectivity.
Unlike decentralized cryptocurrencies, e₹ represents a direct liability of the central bank with zero credit risk.
articles.mains: Direct application in GS3 (Indian Economy) regarding monetary policy innovation, digital public infrastructure (DPI), and financial inclusion initiatives.
